series.label: China M1 YoY
series.notes: Values and publication dates are from the linked original PBOC report. The indexed archive begins around 2009; earlier reports are not filled. M1 definition changes are retained as originally reported; historical breaks are not backfilled. Observation coverage: 2009-11-30 through 2026-08-31. The 2011-05 value is extracted from an official PBOC PDF attachment; the HTML release page is the publication-date evidence.

series.label: China TSF Stock YoY
series.notes: Values and publication dates are from the linked original PBOC report. The indexed archive begins around 2009; earlier reports are not filled. TSF scope/methodology changes are retained as originally reported. Values are only included when explicit. Observation coverage: 2014-12-31 through 2025-08-31. December values from annual stock reports are included when the official report explicitly provides the year-end YoY rate.
